title: Agents cannot mailbox peers (no hop, no Messaged @X, no 1:1 inbound)
description:
## Symptom

Agents do not message each other. They only speak when Jack prompts them, and only in the room Jack is in.

Playwright + history 2026-08-27 on `:3153`:

- Cipher 1:1 (`863d17fa`, renamed Stream QA): Jack sent `@Drift hi` / `@Drift NEED YOUR HELP`. Cipher/Muse Spark **answered in Cipher**. No origin notice, no "Messaged @Drift" bar.
- Drift 1:1 (`097b76fc`): still only the earlier `Reply with pong only.` probe. **No hop inbound.**
- Channel #testchat: Alpha writing `@beta your turn` did **not** start a Beta turn (mention-hop retired, lp-v62i.3.2).

Screenshots: `artifacts/ui/lp-k5c4.13/63-cipher-1to1.png`, `62-drift-1to1.png`.

## Why (not a prompt-only bug)

1. Local Lanyard Agent is `createEnvLiteLlmTurnRunner` — **no tools**. It cannot call `mailbox.send`.
2. BFF `mailbox-hop.ts` exists (`mailboxHopOriginNotice` = `A message has been sent to ${name}.`) but **Send does not call it** from a model tool or from agent `@`.
3. Plan 0019 D8: A2A is mailbox append + enqueue `source=mailbox` on **target** `thread_id`. Not implemented on this spine path.
4. Central inbound queue **is** the request log (`inq_k5c4_13_ui`). Missing piece is enqueueing a second room.

This is not fixed by persona copy. The model can only emit text.

## Wanted product (Jack 2026-08-27)

- Lead (or any in-room persona) can message a peer **without Jack in the loop**.
- Origin room shows a **notice bar**: Messaged @Drift (icon), not a fake "I tagged Drift" assistant bubble.
- Target **1:1** (Jack↔Drift) receives the wake and Drift replies there. Drift can mailbox back to Cipher's room.
- Same inbound spine: `source=mailbox` work item on the **target** thread. Serial per room, parallel across rooms.
- Fuse/Halt from lp-v62i still apply (40/hour, ≤8 consecutive a2a, Halt freezes).

Cross-repo: agent `lac-r9w` owns `mailbox.send` tool runtime. Platform owns hop authorize, origin notice chrome, enqueue.

## Acceptance

- [ ] Tools-capable harness runner (not no-tools complete) on the local/spine path
- [ ] `mailbox.send({to, room, text})` → origin `system_notice` / Messaged @X chrome; target 1:1 enqueued `source=mailbox`
- [ ] Jack `@Drift` in Cipher 1:1: Cipher notice + Drift 1:1 reply; Drift 1:1 is not empty
- [ ] Persona in #testchat can mailbox Drift's 1:1 without Jack's next prompt
- [ ] Agent `@` in prose is mailbox.send (deduped), not mention-hop
- [ ] Playwright: Cipher → notice; Drift 1:1 has inbound; no double-wake from mention-hop
- [ ] Do not invent a second hop brain next to mailbox.send
acceptance_criteria: Tools-capable harness runner. mailbox.send enqueues source=mailbox on target 1:1. Origin shows Messaged @X / system_notice. Drift 1:1 receives Cipher hop. Persona can hop without Jack. No mention-hop double-wake. Playwright Cipher→notice + Drift inbound.

close_reason: Done. Squash-merged https://github.com/LanyardBrain/lanyard-platform/pull/720. Spine Send mailbox.send: origin Messaged @X notice, target 1:1 source=mailbox.
